source.query: SELECT event_id, object_id, object_type, operation, status_code, DATE_FORMAT(started_at, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS started_at, DATE_FORMAT(event_time, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS event_time, DATE_FORMAT(logged_at, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS logged_at, '__BATCH__' AS batch_id FROM status_log WHERE logged_at > '__CURSOR__' AND logged_at <= '__UPPER__' ORDER BY logged_at, event_id
